skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target, with a 100% chance to inflict [Corrosion] on the main target for 2 turns (DoT equal to 8% ATK).

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 3 combo strikes to a single target for 70% ATK DMG each, plus extra DMG equal to 50% of your own lost HP.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 3 combo strikes to a single target for 88% ATK DMG each, plus extra DMG equal to 75% of your own lost HP.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. While own HP is below 50%, continuously grants yourself [Tenacity] (absorbs DMG equal to 10% of own max HP), up to 3 times per turn.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. While own HP is below 50%, continuously grants yourself [Tenacity] (absorbs DMG equal to 15% of own max HP), up to 3 times per turn.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. While own HP is below 50%, continuously grants yourself [Tenacity] (absorbs DMG equal to 18% of own max HP), up to 3 times per turn.

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage over time and damage types (Damage, Internal Damage, Charge).
Corrosive damage over time effect, each turn dealing damage equal to a percentage of ST (e.g. 300%) to the target.
